q: The excess free energy above equilibrium equals k_BT times:
opts: The entropy of the current state
The KL divergence of the current distribution from the Gibbs equilibrium
The energy of the current state
exp: F(q) = F(p*) + k_BT · D_KL(q||p*) where p*∝e^{-E/k_BT} is equilibrium. Minimising free energy = minimising KL divergence from equilibrium. This is the information-theoretic formulation of the second law.
